name: Eagles Campground - Beulah
note: Beulah Park District campground on the west side of ND 49 opposite Riverside Park: one row of pads on a gravel loop between the highway and the Knife River, entered from the cross street at the ND 49 junction. The Park District mentions no restrooms or showers. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Beulah Park District Eagles Campground page (beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/, read 2026-11-12): 'Located on Hwy 49 across from Riverside Park', '10 electrical sites only with water. Dumping station on site', '$25 per day. $140 per week. $420 per month', 'Open seasonally only from May thru October', back-in rule, banner 'CLOSED FOR THE 2026 SEASON'; its own booking list (available-sites?fwp_campground=eagles-campground) sells Sites 1-6 and 8-10 by the night at $25 -> a real park-district RV campground selling single nights. ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 25: BEULAH EAGLES PARK, 1101 Highway 49 South, owner Beulah Parks and Recreation, 10 lots - licensed separately from row 26 BEULAH RIVERSIDE PARK (10 lots) = existing 5985. Separate from 5985: own page, own booking list, own licence, west of ND 49 with its own access from the cross street, while Riverside's sites sit east of the highway across the Knife River bridge (pins 220 m apart). Not 6018 (Bismarck's Eagles Park, 77 km away). Esri imagery 2026-11-12 (z18/z19 at 47.2551,-101.7864 and 47.2550,-101.7864): 10 pads in one row along the west side of a gravel loop, each ~8 m (~26 ft) with open ground on both ends -> a 23-ft rig fits. No horse facilities or mention; no road warning. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule. Not on RV Life (Algolia geo query 3 km, 2026-11-12). Long-stay tests: nights sold online; weekly/monthly rates but no count of long-stay vs nightly sites (test 4 passes on no count).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (700 m frame at 47.2550,-101.7860; z18 at 47.2551,-101.7864; z19 at 47.2547,-101.7867 and 47.2550,-101.7864): the pad row runs N-S along the west side of the gravel loop; the Knife River (~14 m wide here, creek-size) bends past its south-west end, ~15-25 m from the southern 3 pads, but a continuous band of brush and trees ~15-20 m deep plus a bank-top footpath lies between every pad and the water; the northern pads face an open hay field, not the river. No site map or photo shows a pad on open ground to the water -> not waterfront (no view value exists for a creek). No dam nearby.

fees.note: $25 a night, $140 a week, $420 a month, paid in full when booked. Beulah Park District, read 2026-11-12.

fees_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('Rates are $25 per day. $140 per week. $420 per month'; 'All camping reservations are paid in full at the time of the booking') and https://www.beulahparks.com/available-sites/?sites=campsites&fwp_campground=eagles-campground (Sites 1-6, 8-10 'From $ 25.00 per night'), read 2026-11-12
hookups_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('10 electrical sites only with water'), read 2026-11-12. Amperage unpublished (electric key omitted); sewer unpublished. The booking list labels each site 'Electric Only', the same label it uses at Riverside Park.

sites.note: Ten electric sites in one row (Sites 1-10; the online list shows nine, without Site 7). Back-in only unless the office approves otherwise.

sites_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('10 electrical sites'; 'All campers must back into all sites unless approved by the Eagles Campground Office') and the available-sites list (Sites 1-6, 8-10), read 2026-11-12; Esri imagery 2026-11-12 shows 10 pads
facilities_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('Dumping station on site'; 'RV dump station is located on the north/west side of the office'), read 2026-11-12

season.note: May through October, dates depending on the weather.

season_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('Open seasonally only from May thru October, dates dependent upon the weather'), read 2026-11-12

booking.note: Booked online through the Park District and paid in full. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out noon; arrivals after 8 p.m. must arrange check-in ahead (701-870-0602).

booking_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ ('Reserve a Campsite'; 'All camping reservations are paid in full at the time of the booking'; 'If your arrival is later than 8pm you must make prior check-in arrangements by calling 701-870-0602. Check-in time is 3pm and check-out at 12pm') and the available-sites list, read 2026-11-12

status.reopens: not announced (the board will decide for the 2027 season)
status.note: Closed for the 2026 season by the Beulah Park District board on January 5, 2026, with no reason recorded; the board said it would reevaluate for 2027. The October 5, 2026 minutes report it was reopened for work crews who could not find spots in town. Call the Park District before planning a stay.

status_source: https://www.beulahparks.com/parks-campgrounds/eagles-campground/ (banner 'CLOSED FOR THE 2026 SEASON'); Beulah Park District minutes https://www.beulahparks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/PD-Meeting-1-5-2026.docx ('Eagles Campground - discussion was made and Eagles Campground will be closed for the 2026 season. The board will reevaluate for the 2027 season.') and https://www.beulahparks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PD-Meeting-10-5-26.docx ('Dutchuk reopened Eagles Campground for campers that couldn't find spots while in town working.'); Feb-Sep and Nov 2026 minutes say nothing more; read 2026-11-12
